steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Guard, explain yourself.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: I must look exactly like a Reunion member... huh?

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: So you know each other.

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: Right, so everything this Cautus said was a lie.

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: You and Reunion have always been on the same side! Isn't that right?!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: ...Tati... Did you find any food? The people in the shelter don't have long.

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: What more do you want from me?!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Let's get you to someplace safe first.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Stay away from her, Guard!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: I'm staying back.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: ...I know things might be hard to explain.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: But we have to be careful. All the Ursus here became Infected of no fault of their own... and they've had a tough time.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Most of them are already on the verge of mental breakdown... All it takes is someone to push them over the edge.

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: We've had it 'tough?' You're psycho murderers! Sadistic freaks!

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: Because of you... look what happened to me! Look what I've become!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: But if you don't leave right now, the devils will find you. You'll be handed over to Reunion.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Patriot's troops have completely pulled out of this area. If you're caught, I can't save you at that point.

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: Then just let me die! I'd rather die than watch you monsters run rampant!

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: What about guerrillas or this so called 'Aegis of the Infected?' ...Are they any different from the rest of Reunion?!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: They are. Without them, we'd be dead already.

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: Tell me then! Right now!

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: If they're just trying to do the right thing, why are they still with Reunion? Why'd they do this to our homes?!

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: Why aren't they rebelling? Why aren't they walking out?! Why did they do all this even knowing we've been spat on, persecuted, and killed?

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: Why didn't your great guerrillas fight back against the patrolling devils? Why?!

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: I watched them... they used their own hands... to rip... tear...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Patriot can't be everywhere at once.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: When Patriot has to command his forces to defend the sanctity of life, something has gone horribly wrong.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: But... as long as the guerrillas still continue to pass through this area, I can assure you that the truly wicked in Reunion will not set foot here.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: That is the difference between Reunion's thugs and Patriot's guerrilla warriors. Patriot, and the Sarkaz as a whole, are much more disciplined than Reunion's ranks.

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: Where are they then?! Why aren't they here?

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: When they left, the other Infected were so much worse, so cruel!

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: How is that not their fault? If not for the guerrillas, they never would've turned against us like this, right?! They're just out for revenge on the guerrillas!!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: ...You're wrong.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: The guerrillas did the right thing. And while as you said, some may be trying to take revenge on the guerrillas...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: They gave you a chance to survive, so Reunion is retaliating against them. That is all.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: No, they did more than that... One might even say they're defending your dignity. I saw it with my own eyes.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: I saw the soldier telling the others to call you by your names, rather than your numbers.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Isn't that right?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: And, the reason they left us alone was so that we could help you when they are away.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: ...Chernobog has already been cut up into many pieces.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: There are some places that the guerrillas are stationed, but also many where they are not... If no one can maintain discipline, then if you want to survive... you can only depend on us.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: And that's even assuming we survive.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Amiya, do you believe what I said just now?

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: No!

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: Cautus girl, look... Look! He's Reunion!

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: How can you believe anything coming from Reunion? And what about me? Am I supposed to buy into their bullshit now that I'm Infected?

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: Look, the people you said wanted to murder us... aren't they Reunion?

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: Now that I'm Infected, is Reunion suddenly going to take me in and treat me better? How the hell am I supposed to know who's who, and which one of you is going to kill me?

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: You, Reunion, all of you should just... should just...!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Amiya.)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: (Dr. Kal'tsit?)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Don't get worked up.)

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Kal'tsit?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Kal'tsit, we should keep moving.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Why are you here...?! You, of all people!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Are you... trying to eradicate Reunion completely?! Rhodes Island, you're really no better...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: ...Forget that for now! The Sarkaz mercenary patrol is going to pass through this warehouse soon!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: If we don't deal with them, or at least hide, they're going to find us and take us away...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Not to mention the regular Reunion patrols. We don't have much time to find supplies!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: That's why so many are starving, and short on medicine. There's a lot of death among the people of Chernobog.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Amiya, Dr. Kal'tsit! Also... Dr. {@nickname}, I really hope you can trust me. Or at least find somewhere to hide!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Guard...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Infected Ursus woman.

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: Do you mean me?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Infected Ursus woman, I have some honest questions for you.

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: Y-your accent... you're from the capital of the Empire, aren't you?

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: But the way you speak, it's so old-fashioned...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You're educated.

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: ...I was a copyist at a university, before.

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: It's all gone now, thanks to you Infected.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: All right, do you trust the man behind you? Our Infected former employee, now with Reunion?

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: He's... your employee?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: One of Rhodes Island's functions is helping innocent Infected survive in a combat environment.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Whether or not you are innocent remains to be seen...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: However.

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: Aaaahh!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit!

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: Y-you, your... what... is... mmng...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: ...never thought I'd see a day when Mon3tr was after me.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The blade pressed against your throat has an incision angle of only eight degrees. Another six millimeters deeper and it severs an artery.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Miss.

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: Um, err...?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Did he truly work so hard to ensure your survival, as he claimed?

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: What are you asking... What are you getting at?!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Did he and his Reunion element, or any part thereof, threaten your life or take any action to harm you?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I will deal with him in accordance with your response.

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: Are you threatening me with his life?! I... we... we had nothing to do with each other!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: What about him, individually? Did he go along with Reunion and their crimes against humanity?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Doctor... Kal'tsit... I'm insulted!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I can only rely on the words of eyewitnesses and victims. Since you claim to have guaranteed her right to life, then I have only the young lady's testimony by which to adjudicate your claim.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You gave only your side of the story.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: But what she says is also—

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: She's in a different position.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You have power. You can use violence. It doesn't matter what you did with that violence.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I felt it.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Amiya, it's the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: The targets are getting close.

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: Couldn't... but he...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Did he or did he not protect you from Reunion? Did he or did he not effectively keep you safe from their aggression?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit...! The patrol is here! It's not... it's not the guerrillas! You can't... Don't let them...

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: You're not making any sense!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I am confident our actions are well within the ethical parameters of Ursus. It was you who made the accusation against him.

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: He... he did go out regularly, about this time...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit! Let me... stop the Sarkaz! Or at least... let me get them to go someplace else!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I need an answer.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Speak. Or we will never know the truth.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Twenty-four meters out, in a straight line. Very close.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Twenty-two meters.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Mon3tr.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit!

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: No! He didn't! He didn't do anything wrong!

steps.name: Ursus Infected
steps.text: At least... at least nothing I saw!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya, Doctor.

options: You put on a good show.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Thank you for your time.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Darn it... Dr. Kal'tsit! I knew it...!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Let's go, Doctor!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Our next target is Reunion's Sarkaz patrol team!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I'm coming too.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Guard, was it?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: You're wrong about me. But I'll protect you. I'll get your revenge for you.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: They'll pay for what they did to you, and my family, and the common people. They'll all pay, for all of it.
